Unsatisfactory Experience – Please Be Cautious

I am sharing my experience to help other customers stay informed before visiting Gunjan Electronics.

I recently visited the store to purchase two phones for my parents (Oppo and Realme). From the beginning, the overall customer service was not very welcoming, and the interaction with the owner felt dismissive. Most of the process was handled by the staff without clear communication.

There were also concerns regarding the billing and loan documentation. This mismatch in the documentation was unexpected and concerning.

Additionally, the ₹5,000 amount was later described as a “processing fee,” which was not clearly explained at the time of payment. This lack of transparency added to the confusion.
When I raised these concerns at the store, the response was not satisfactory, and the discussion became uncomfortable instead of being resolved professionally.

I would strongly recommend that customers carefully verify all billing details, loan documents, and charges before completing any purchase.

Financial Forgery: I paid ₹5,000 as a downpayment. When I got home, I discovered they had falsified my loan documents. They processed my application as a purchase for one phone and a COOLER. They are literally committing document wrong to manipulate sales figures or pocket commissions!

Theft Under the Guise of Fees: They took my ₹5,000 downpayment by suddenly claiming it was a 'processing fee' after the fact. This is a blatant scam customers.

Threats and Intimidation: The owner and his staff have zero professional ethics. When I stood my ground, they started screaming at me and threatening me. This is how they handle customers who realize they’ve been cheated.

If you value your money, your privacy, and your safety, NEVER PURCHASE ANYTHING FROM GUNJAN ELECTRONICS.

STAY AWAY FROM GUNJAN ELECTRONICS.

featured_reviews.review_text:
From my recent interaction with Darshan Electronics Sales and Services in IC Colony, Borivali west, I can confidently affirm that it is the go-to shop for all your electronics needs. My requirement was a bit peculiar - I needed a window AC on rent for just three months. Not only did they have the item I needed, but the whole process from the selection of the AC to its installation and final return was streamlined and efficient.

The service offered by Darshan Electronics Sales and Services goes beyond the usual customer experience. The key highlight of my experience was interacting with Mr. Hasmukhji, who oversees the operations. Hasmukhji was more than just a salesman or a service provider; he was genuinely invested in ensuring that my needs were met. Always reachable either on call or in person, Hasmukhji exuded an aura of authenticity and dedication that is often hard to find in today's fast-paced world.

Apart from his affable personality, what set Hasmukhji apart was his professionalism. There was no unnecessary delay or roundabout talks; his approach was straightforward and to the point. His promptness extended to financial dealings as well. I never had to follow up for my deposit; the money was transferred back to my account even before the AC was loaded back into his vehicle at the end of the rental period.

Furthermore, I was particularly impressed by the condition of the window AC I rented. Despite being a hard-to-find model, it was well-maintained and functioned impeccably throughout the rental period.

I will certainly reach out to them for any of my future electronics needs and would highly recommend them to anyone in need of electronic products or services. An exceptional experience all around!
